items.title: Lilly signs $5.9B deal with Stipple Bio on oncology targets
items.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a $5.9bn partnership with Stipple Bio on oncology drug candidates designed to target tumour cells more precisely.

items.title: STRIDE-RCT: cancer-detecting blood tests to be offered to 20,000 NHS patients via 200 GP practices
items.summary: The STRIDE-RCT trial will offer blood tests for early cancer signals to over 20,000 patients aged 45+ with abdominal symptoms at 200 GP surgeries. First tests: Proteotype (Enlighten), Pinpoint AI (PinPoint) and Mercy Bioanalytics (Halo); more may be added. Source: Evening Standard.

items.title: BOPA Position Statement – DPYD guided dosing for Tegafur containing products
items.summary: The BOPA Genomics Cancer Advisory Group has been made aware that some centres in the UK are considering using Teysuno products in patients who may otherwise have been started…

items.title: AI-assisted breast cancer screening trial hopes to ‘free up staff time’
items.summary: Thousands of women are set to take part in the world’s largest artificial intelligence (AI) assisted breast cancer screening trial, NHS England has confirmed.

items.title: UKMS Pharmacy Group – Education Day 2026
items.summary: The UK Myeloma Society Pharmacy Group (a special-interest group affiliated to BOPA) is running its 4th Annual Educational Meeting, on-line on Tuesday 1st December.

items.title: Have Your Say: Review the First UK SACT Protocol and Provide Feedback
items.summary: Dear Colleagues working in cancer services We are writing to invite you to review and provide feedback on the first protocol produced as part of the UK SACT Protocols Pilot.

items.title: GSK wins FDA approval for Nelkarmi, its second lung cancer drug from the Nuvalent deal
items.summary: GSK secured its third high-profile FDA approval in recent weeks with Nelkarmi, the second lung cancer drug from its $10.6bn acquisition of Nuvalent earlier this year.

items.title: Macmillan lends support to UK prostate cancer data project
items.summary: Prostate Progress, a data-powered project to find better tests, treatments and care for prostate cancer, is expanding through an alliance with Macmillan.

items.title: RevMed hails first-line data with pancreatic cancer drug
items.summary: Revolution Medicines reports first-line pancreatic cancer results for its pan-RAS inhibitor Rasonque.

items.title: Erasca data add to pressure facing Revolution's breakthrough cancer drug
items.summary: Rasonque is off to one of the best oncology launches in history, but limitations leave room for rivals such as Erasca, nearing a Phase 3 trial.

items.title: Roche’s Wilserdly wins FDA approval as fourth oral SERD for breast cancer
items.summary: Roche’s giredestrant (Wilserdly) won FDA approval for certain patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer; some analysts project peak sales above $10bn.

items.title: FDA complete response letter for Summit’s ivonescimab cites China-heavy data beyond survival miss
items.summary: The FDA’s rejection of Summit Therapeutics’ PD-1xVEGF bispecific ivonescimab goes beyond the previously reported failure to show a statistically significant overall survival benefit, with the letter also citing China-heavy trial data.

items.title: Merck wins US and German rulings over Halozyme in Keytruda Qlex patent fight
items.summary: Merck has won legal rulings in the US and Germany against Halozyme, clearing hurdles to commercialising subcutaneous Keytruda in both markets.

items.title: Merck’s TROP2 ADC extends overall survival in pivotal gastroesophageal cancer trial
items.summary: Merck’s sacituzumab tirumotecan improved overall survival in a phase 3 gastroesophageal cancer trial, a second pivotal global win for the TROP2 antibody-drug conjugate.

items.title: NICE approves capsule sponge test for oesophageal cancer in primary care
items.summary: NICE has approved the use of a capsule sponge test to detect oesophageal cancer and Barrett’s oesophagus in primary care and community settings. Two tests – Cytosponge and EndoSign – have been recommended for use on the NHS under new draft guidance.

items.title: NICE backs ‘sponge on a string’ test for detecting oesophageal cancer
items.summary: A new less-invasive alternative to endoscopy is being recommended by the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) as a test for oesophageal cancer in people at high risk of the condition.

items.title: Compromised flushing fluid neutrality during sequential chemotherapy administration: an observational study
items.summary: Background: Maintaining the neutrality of flushing fluid is essential to keep patients safe from potential drug interaction and to protect nurses from potential exposure risk to hazardous drugs used in systemic anti-cancer therapy (SACT) when disconnecting infusion lines.

items.title: New handbook offers practical advice to help improve NHS services for patients with head and neck cancer
items.summary: GIRFT: A new implementation handbook from the Getting It Right First Time (GIRFT) programme provides practical guidance to help NHS organisations improve head and neck cancer services.

items.title: Sepalna approved in Europe for ovarian cancer
items.summary: Sepalna has been approved in Europe as a maintenance option after first-line chemotherapy for ovarian cancer.

items.title: New life-extending anal cancer treatment available on NHS, NICE confirms
items.summary: A life-extending advanced anal cancer treatment has been approved by NICE and is available immediately on the NHS. It is estimated around 250 people in England are set to benefit from the new targeted treatment for anal cancer which has spread and cannot be removed through surgery.

items.title: How my father’s cancer journey helped reshape cancer care at Nuffield Health
items.summary: As a cancer nurse specialist and national lead for cancer services at Nuffield Health, I have spent more than two decades supporting people through treatment.

items.title: UK BMT Pharmacists Group Educational Meeting – Friday 13th November 2026. Time:14:00 to 16:00
items.summary: The next UK BMT Pharmacists Group Educational Meeting is on Friday 13th November, 2pm–4pm.

items.title: New UK SACT Board National Intrathecal and Intraventricular SACT Guidance
items.summary: Dear colleagues, We are pleased to share the newly published UK SACT Board National Guidance on the Safe Administration of Systemic Anti-Cancer Therapies via the Intrathecal or Intraventricular Routes.

items.title: BOPA members flying the flag for cancer pharmacy at ESMO 2026
items.summary: It was fantastic to see BOPA members representing cancer pharmacy at ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, which brought together the global cancer community from 23 to 27 October to…

items.title: US FDA 510(k) — Non-sterile, Powder Free Nitrile Examination Gloves, Tested for use with Chemotherapy Drugs, Fentanyl Citrate and Simulated Gastric Acid Fluid/ Fentanyl Citrate Injection Mix  Blue
Cancer blood test trial begins in 200 GP practices
items.summary: An NHS trial to test the effectiveness of a blood test to detect a range of cancers is being rolled out across 200 GP practices. More than 20,000 patients will take place in the study to assess whether a blood test can spot prostate, ovarian, bowel, pancreatic, stomach, liver and other abdominal cancers.

items.title: Publication of Pharmaceutical Technology and Pharmacology of Parenteral Oncology Drugs
items.summary: We are delighted to recognise the recent publication of Pharmaceutical Technology and Pharmacology of Parenteral Oncology Drugs, a new book bringing together expertise from oncology pharmacy professionals across the world.

items.title: Acute and Supportive Oncology Clinical Consensus Statement
items.summary: BOPA welcomes the Acute and Supportive Oncology Clinical Consensus Statement, to which we were pleased to contribute.

items.title: Women from marginalised groups waiting longer for breast cancer care
items.summary: Black patients and those with learning disabilities face longer waiting times for breast cancer care, a new nationwide study has found.

items.title: Holistic support of patients with breast cancer in primary care
items.summary: The impact of breast cancer is multi-faceted and can extend far beyond the period of active cancer treatment, affecting the person physically, psychologically, socially, economically and spiritually.

items.title: Six suppliers share £850m national chemotherapy medicines framework via HealthTrust Europe
items.summary: A new eight-year national framework for aseptically prepared systemic anti-cancer therapy medicines has gone live via HealthTrust Europe, hosted by Mid South Essex NHS Foundation Trust, with a combined value of up to £850 million.
